headline: Sempra Global -- Moody's downgrades Sempra Energy to Baa2 from Baa1; stable outlook
summary: Moody's Investors Service, ("Moody's") downgraded the ratings of Sempra Energy (Sempra), including its senior unsecured and Issuer rating to Baa2 from Baa1 and its junior subordinate rating to Baa3 from Baa2 (see full debt list below). Concurrently, Moody's assigned Baa2 ratings to the unsecured bank credit facilities of Sempra ($1.250 billion) and Sempra Global ($3.185 billion), which are both scheduled to expire in May 2024.

headline: Infraestructura Energetica Nova S.A.B de C.V. -- Moody's downgrades IEnova to Baa2/Aa2.mx; outlook negative
summary: Moody's de Mexico S.A. de C.V, ("Moody´s") has today downgraded Infraestructura Energética Nova S.A.B de C.V.'s ("IEnova") debt ratings to Baa2 (Global Scale, local currency) from Baa1 and to Aa2.mx (Mexico National Scale) from Aa1.mx. The rating downgrade follows the recent rating actions on the ratings and outlooks of the Government of Mexico (Baa1 negative), Comisión Federal de Electricidad ("CFE"; Baa1/Aa1.mx negative) and Petróleos Mexicanos ("PEMEX"; Ba2/A2.mx negative).
